messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up  GCP + EdgeAccel want a co-hosted webinar + hands-on mini-lab at ComputeSummit on Dec 2. Need speaker list, lab infra, and swag split. Who volunteers to coordinate?

Owen (devrel): I can run the hands-on lab and lab repo. Need a clean demo that runs in <20 mins and a quick teardown guide.

Priya (GCP): GCP can sponsor credits for the lab (2x n1-highmem preemptible) and amplify registration. We need a one-page listing by Nov 1.

Sam (EdgeAccel): EdgeAccel will bring a prototype inference card and an onsite engineer. We'll need to validate drivers and provide an example container.

Leo (eng): I'll validate container and provide a fallback host on Redwood Dedicated. Propose a health-check and canned recording as backup.

Grace (marketing): Swag ask: 250 co-branded tote bags and 500 stickers. Also want a QR postcard linking to the lab repo. Ship to our NY staging address for kit build.

Maya (partnerships): Action items:
- Maya: runbook + invites (due Oct 15)
- Owen: lab repo + instructions (due Nov 10)
- Leo: container + fallback test (due Nov 20)
- Sam: hardware test window + engineer contact (due Nov 5)
- Priya: listing template + promo blurb (due Nov 1)
- Grace: swag PO + QR postcard (due Oct 30)

event-bot: Created calendar event "ComputeSummit: Redwood x GCP x EdgeAccel" on Dec 2; invites sent.

Owen (devrel): I'll draft a minimal lab README and demo script: 1) spin container, 2) run inference on sample dataset, 3) compare latency vs cloud. Will add troubleshooting notes.

Leo (eng): For fallback: if EdgeAccel card not present, switch to Dedicated via env var REDWOOD_FALLBACK=true and run local docker-compose demo.

Sam (EdgeAccel): We'll ship a test unit to NY staging by Nov 10. Tracker number to follow.

Grace (marketing): I'll request logo EPS from partners; need them by Oct 25 for tote mockups.

Maya (partnerships): Great. If everyone's good, I'll lock dates and start the Notion runbook. React with :white_check_mark: if you can meet deadlines.

Owen (devrel): :white_check_mark:
